payload.claim: The Notes section discloses that the git facts underpinning review_commit_diff (rename pairing without --no-renames, empty-pathspec behavior, --literal-pathspecs placement and exit codes) were measured on the host's git 2.54 and not on the cell image's git 2.39.5, leaving the witnesses to settle them in the cell. These facts were independently reproduced on a different git minor version (2.47.3) and are long-standing, version-insensitive plumbing behaviors, so this residual gap is real but very low-risk and already disclosed to the operator.
